serverInfo.name: jkfertilizers-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: J K Fertilizers MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Model Context Protocol server for J K Fertilizers (Anand, Gujarat, India). Provides autonomous discovery, product specifications, technical assays, B2B procurement calculations, and contract manufacturing resources for AI agents.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the J K Fertilizers product catalog by category, active nutrient, or crop application.

tools.name: get_product_assay
tools.description: Retrieve technical assay, nutrient breakdown, particle size distribution, and FCO compliance parameters for a specific product.

tools.name: get_b2b_pricing_quote
tools.description: Calculate volume-tiered wholesale pricing estimates, minimum order quantities (MOQ), and shipping estimates for bulk orders.

destination_state.description: Destination Indian state or country for logistics estimate

resources.name: LLM Knowledge Base
resources.description: Structured overview of J K Fertilizers products, company history, and specifications.

resources.name: B2B Pricing & Terms
resources.description: Wholesale pricing matrix, volume tiers, MOQ, payment terms, and delivery guidelines.

resources.name: Agent Skills Directory
resources.description: Autonomous agent skills index for procurement, contract manufacturing, and catalog queries.

prompts.name: recommend_fertilizer
prompts.description: Recommend optimal organic fertilizer and granule combinations based on soil conditions, crop type, and agronomic goals.

arguments.name: crop_type
arguments.description: Target crop (e.g. cotton, sugarcane, wheat, horticulture, paddy)

arguments.name: soil_type
arguments.description: Soil characteristics (e.g. black cotton, alluvial, sandy, saline)

prompts.name: draft_inquiry
prompts.description: Draft a formal B2B procurement inquiry or contract manufacturing proposal for J K Fertilizers sales desk.

arguments.name: requirements
arguments.description: Granule formulation, volume, and packaging specifications
